item.title: My Child Struggles with Reading: Functional Vision & How It Impacts Learning - Beyond Boundaries
item.description: As parents, we all want what’s best for our children’s health and their learning. So, it comes as no surprise to hear that vision and reading go hand-in-hand. In order to read well, children need to see well. But even for a child with 20/20 vision, there is more to vision than just how well they see. It is estimated that 15-20% of kids struggle with reading due to poor functional vision skills.

item.title: Baby Sign Language: How and When to Teach, from the Experts - Beyond Boundaries
item.description: When our kids are babies, we wish there was a manual on deciphering what each cry or grunt means. Are they hungry? Tired? Full? As they approach toddler age, this task becomes a little easier, but there is still that language barrier as they are learning to form words and phrases. Enter baby sign language!
